install: uv run --frozen --no-sync python -c 'import os, pathlib; p = pathlib.Path.home() / ".pgpass"; p.touch(mode=0o600, exist_ok=True); p.chmod(0o600); password = os.environ["POSTGRES_PASSWORD"].replace("\\", "\\\\").replace(":", "\\:"); p.write_text("127.0.0.1:5432:*:postgres:" + password + "\n")'

db.cmd: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.override.yml up --no-deps db

mailpit.cmd: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.override.yml up --no-deps mailpit

backend.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.override.yml exec -T db pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d app -q; do sleep 1; done' && cd backend && uv run --frozen --no-sync bash scripts/prestart.sh && exec uv run --frozen --no-sync fastapi dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT"

web.cmd: cd frontend && exec bun run dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --strictPort
